purpose: Distinguish threshold calibration, underfitting and wrong spatial support in the scientifically failed v10 Phase-A checkpoint without adding optimizer steps.
required_outputs: threshold-free average precision by split, event and group
absolute threshold sweep of foreground recall, precision and background FPR
six-view predicted-R, continuous-target and support-overlay PNG for every group

decision_rule.good_ordering_but_miscalibrated: Create a new v10.1 calibration/objective protocol; do not reclassify v10.
decision_rule.wrong_spatial_support_on_weak_events: Repair route/task conditioning or support labels before any additional training steps.
decision_rule.uniformly_improving_but_underfit: A new longer Phase-A-only smoke may be proposed after this replay; v10 is never extended in place.

claim_boundary: Evaluation-only replay of a failed engineering checkpoint. It cannot establish a passed Stage2-L gate, formal generalization, planning improvement, closed-loop improvement or safety.
